project.name: MockShop — Mock Ecommerce + Donation Site
project.summary: Vite + React + Tailwind frontend; Express server exposes /config.json from env and serves built assets. Analytics helpers emit GTM/GA4 dataLayer events and Matomo _paq; optional Optimizely Web/ODP; consent banner gates categories.
